title: Reindexed sign restriction
statement: Let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and assign signs $z_i\in\{\pm1\}$ to every index outside $J$. The reindexed restriction is the function on $\{\pm1\}^{|J|}$ obtained by inserting the input signs into the coordinates of $J$ in increasing order, using $z_i$ on all coordinates outside $J$, and evaluating $f$.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
A subset $J$ of the $n$ coordinate indices
A sign assignment to every index outside $J$
